title: async/await: Sequential vs async let

docs.title: Concurrency — Calling Asynchronous Functions in Parallel

hints: `await` in a loop runs one fetch at a time.
Use `withTaskGroup` to start all fetches at once; carry each index so you can restore input order.
`group.addTask { (i, await fetchUser(id)) }` then `for await (i, user) in group { result[i] = user }`.
